_note: Source: the creator's own description of CuTTI (November 2026). Both tools are private and in active development; nothing here claims availability, partnerships or measured accuracy.
intro: CuTTI is a pair of tools built by CR Srikanth for his own composing, with SVLS LABS LLP. They do not replace the composer. They take on the drudgery between an idea and a session you can work in, so more of the time goes into the music itself.
quote: They don’t replace the composer. They take on the drudgery between an idea and a session I can work in, so more of my time goes into the music itself.
status: Status: both tools are private, built for the composer’s own work, and in active development.
trademarks: Logic Pro is a trademark of Apple Inc.; Cubase, Nuendo, WaveLab and Dorico are trademarks of Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH; Digital Performer is a trademark of MOTU, Inc. CuTTI is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or a partner of these companies.
principles: The composer stays in charge. CuTTI suggests and prepares; the composer decides.
Originality is checked. Every new part is compared against the reference material it learned from, and anything too close is rewritten.
It runs on the composer’s own Mac. A small local AI model only reads the brief.
Projects are never overwritten: every build is a new file.

studio.lead: An idea generator and assistant arranger that builds sessions in the DAW. Describe a song in plain words, or give it a score, and CuTTI Studio plans the song and builds a ready-to-work session in Logic Pro, Cubase, Nuendo or Digital Performer.
studio.brief: A brief can be as short as one line, such as “a dreamy pop song in A minor, 100 BPM”. CuTTI Studio plans the sections, key, tempo and instruments, writes the parts and builds the project. A brief can also be one of the composer’s own scores.
studio.example: Build a cinematic arrangement beginning with solo piano, expanding into warm strings, layered synth textures and a powerful orchestral conclusion.
studio.daws: Logic Pro, Cubase, Nuendo and Digital Performer, on the composer’s own Mac.
studio.demo: In this recording, a single request becomes a complete Logic Pro session: named tracks, built-in instruments, regions cut at every section, then a starting mix.

features.title: From words to a session
features.text: Plans the sections, key, tempo and instruments, then writes the parts and builds the project with named tracks, markers and a starting mix.

features.title: From a score to a song
features.text: Reads a score as a PDF, a photo or MusicXML, keeps the melody note for note, fits chords to it and arranges a band around it, following the score’s own bar lengths and repeats.

features.title: Learns from the composer’s templates
features.text: Has studied the layouts of about 190 of the composer’s own Cubase and Logic templates (folders, buses, effect returns, sends and levels), lays out each new session the way he would, and explains every choice in one plain line.

features.title: A music brain
features.text: Learned song forms, energy curves, transitions and instrument entries shape each arrangement, and the composer’s own words, such as “quiet intro” or “start with the mukhda”, always win.

features.title: Mix and master
features.text: Sets a starting mix on the composer’s own arrangements and masters through WaveLab.

features.title: Dorico loop
features.text: Sends a player list to Dorico, and places the Dorico score back onto the template tracks in any of the DAWs.

score.lead: A desktop app that turns printed music into scores to edit, play and use: from PDFs, scans and phone photos, and from recordings too.
score.workflows: Scan Score reads PDFs and scanned pages. Photo Score straightens a phone photo of a page and corrects its lighting. Audio Score turns a recording or a live performance into notation. In every case the result is a score that can be reviewed, edited, played and exported.
score.statusText: CuTTI Score is built for the composer’s own work and is not on sale. It works hand in hand with CuTTI Studio: a score corrected here becomes a song in the DAW with one line.

features.title: Reads printed music
features.text: From PDFs, scans and phone photos: it straightens the page, corrects the lighting, and recognises clefs, keys, meters, notes, rests, chords, ties, slurs, dynamics and repeats.

features.title: Shows what it is unsure about
features.text: Uncertain spots are marked, so only those need reviewing and they can be fixed quickly.

features.title: Editing with undo
features.text: Pitch, rhythm, accidentals, ties, transposition, key, meter and tempo, with note entry from the computer keyboard or a MIDI keyboard.

features.title: Playback
features.text: A built-in synth or SoundFonts, with a following cursor, loop and metronome.

features.title: Audio to score
features.text: Turns a recording or a live performance into notation.

features.title: Exports
features.text: MusicXML, MIDI, PDF, PNG and WAV. A score corrected here becomes a song in CuTTI Studio with one line.
